Description: Responsible for user registration and login, enforcing unique usernames, distinguishing regular users from administrators, maintaining browser-associated sessions, validating credentials and roles, denying invalid access, and terminating sessions on logout.

Responsible for the movie catalog and its metadata, including paginated listings, total movie counts, movie details, complete cast information, category navigation and filtering, many-to-many movie-category associations, unique-title enforcement, and administrator-only creation, single deletion, and batch deletion of catalog entries.

Responsible for movie video assets independently from catalog metadata, including administrator-authorized uploads of large MP4 files, verification of playback availability, retrieval of missing files from the configured local repository, temporary or serving-area storage, and delivery of video resources for playback and download using the catalog movie title as the expected file correspondence.
